culprit_citations.quoted_text: Morgan Stanley and Co. International PLC | $ | 467,803 | EUR | 443,140 | 3/19/2025 | $ | 7,452 | Unrealized appreciation (depreciation) on foreign currency forward contracts

findings.detail: A 3/19/2025 foreign-currency-forward settlement row from the prior-period derivative schedule was treated as current for report_date 2025-03-31; current foreign-currency-forward rows settle 6/18/2025.

rationale: The maturity_not_past flag is real. The source row with settlement date 3/19/2025 is before the 2025-03-31 report date, but it belongs to the comparative derivative schedule: its table total of 34,954 ties to the prior-period foreign currency forward transactions total in table 136. The current-period foreign currency forward total is 9,005 in table 135, and the current forward-contract detail rows have 6/18/2025 settlements, not 3/19/2025. The defect is therefore a comparative-period row leaking into the current report-date population.
